title: Creature Shock: Special Edition
overview:
Enter the world of Creature Shock. One of the first games to seamlessly pair splashy cinematics with equally gorgeous gameplay. Top-notch action as you battle monsters who are intent on destroying Earth. Beautiful maze-crawling sections are interspersed with a good mix of shoot-it-before-it-gets-you action. The enemy creatures are the biggest and ugliest around.

- Spectacular, full-screen 3-D rendered, ray-traced animation.
- Exciting, varied gameplay with fast paced space shooting and pulse-pounding first-person perspective exploration and combat.
- Incredible suspense heightened by atmospheric music and sound effects.
- 2 full CDs crammed with mutant creatures and cyberspace action adventure.
- New shocking creatures.
- Rocket through the new and unique labyrinth of flying levels.
